_comment: Blind probe set for the relevance gate, written on 2026-10-22 by a separate model (Fable 5.1) from the tenants' public knowledge-base documents only, without seeing any code, retrieval settings or other eval sets; committed before any semantic-model measurement (W5) and never used for tuning. in_scope: colloquial questions with the `##` section that answers them (also: other sections that answer it as well); out_of_scope: questions no document answers, about half of them near misses sharing a word with the documents. ambiguous: out-of-scope items the writer flagged as arguable (the documents say refunds go back the original way, which a strict reader takes as an answer); reported apart, not scored. Scoring rules were fixed before measuring. One question the writer happened to repeat from gate_probe.json (客服电话多少) was dropped, since that set was used for tuning.
